description: Builds UNSIGNED OrderBook.claim(orderId, batchNonce) transactions for every unclaimed fill of your SMX Account in one market, so fills count as a position. Order ids default to your indexed history. Each claim is checked by eth_call first. Never signs.

wallet.description: Your own wallet address (EOA that owns the SMX Account). Never a private key.

name: smx_build_claim
title: SMX: build unsigned claims
